description:
Follow-up to JMAP-tjvm.5 (signature fix). The canonical regression-test pattern landed in crate-jmap-mail-client/tests/submission_query.rs (the existing 'email_submission_query_changes_with_filter_and_sort' test was extended to cover upToId + calculateTotal, and a new 'email_submission_query_changes_all_none_omits_optional_wire_keys' test was added).

The pattern should be replicated for the 15 sibling /queryChanges methods that gained the 4 RFC 8620 §5.6 args in JMAP-tjvm.5:

  - email_query_changes (mail-client)
  - mailbox_query_changes (mail-client)
  - calendar_event_query_changes (calendars-client)
  - calendar_event_notification_query_changes (calendars-client)
  - chat_query_changes (chat-client)
  - chat_contact_query_changes (chat-client)
  - custom_emoji_query_changes (chat-client)
  - message_query_changes (chat-client)
  - space_query_changes (chat-client)
  - contact_card_query_changes (contacts-client)
  - file_node_query_changes (filenode-client)
  - metadata_query_changes (metadata-client)
  - share_notification_query_changes (sharing-client)
  - principal_query_changes (sharing-client)
  - task_query_changes (tasks-client)
  - task_notification_query_changes (tasks-client)

Each method needs at minimum:
  1. A test that passes Some(filter), Some(sort), Some(&up_to_id), Some(true) and asserts all four appear on the wire under the spec keys (filter, sort, upToId, calculateTotal).
  2. A test that passes all None and asserts all four are omitted from the wire.

P3 because the API correctness fix is already in place via JMAP-tjvm.5; these are regression guards for silent-drop bugs and follow the canonical-template propagation rule from workspace AGENTS.md.
title: Wire-shape regression tests for /queryChanges filter/sort/upToId/calculateTotal across siblings
